If the process crashes between Complete-StoreCommit (line 5725) and the retry at 5750, the ledger permanently claims a retry was scheduled but the spool line was never re-attempted, and the event is silently lost. Prior findings (F29/F30/F32)\n\nAll F29-1..2, F30-1..4/6..9 and F32-1..11 are **fixed** in `1de388e`. The F02/F03/F04/F15/F19-1/F22-6 series predate this range (panel/routing/ratings/scoreboard code marked `implemented` at `c6f6966`) and were **not re-checked** in this wave-28 pass.\n\n- **Kick (D1)** `common.ps1:8377-8415`, `consult.ps1:1257-1273`: per-request id, atomic temp+rename, joiner takes the existing id and never overwrites, only the creator removes the ack after a 1 s grace, `Clear-StaleKickAck` sweeps >60 s acks. F29-2/F30-1/F32-1/F30-6 fixed.\n- **Transactional hide (D3/D4)** `common.ps1:5562-5624`: snapshot→remove in `try`→restore+rethrow; engine start refuses on hide failure. F30-2/F30-4 fixed.\n- **Bounded reader (D5)** `common.ps1:8416-8477`: only new bytes scanned, carry capped 1 MiB, multibyte split safe. F30-3/F32-8 fixed.\n- **Health retry (D8)** `consult.ps1:5711-5753`: in-lock 1×1 s, full retry after the lock, cause named. F29-1/F30-7/F32-2/F32-3 fixed (residual #1).\n- **Coordinator (D9-D12)** `common.ps1:5654-5846`: resolved triple, `in_roster:false`+console line, `#n`→warning not refusal, shared identity rule, weaker provider warning. F30-8/F30-9/F32-4/F32-5/F32-6 fixed.\n- **Hook/`-Explain` (D13/D15)** `hook.ps1:113-115`, `consult.ps1:887-898`: full path, `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` substituted, stream disposed. Fixed (residuals #2/#3).\n\n**F30-5 (docs vs code):** the `-Kick` caller text `consult.ps1:1274-1278` matches the code — \"late\"=outcome stands, \"stopped\"=salvaged, first reply stands. Consistent.\n\n## 2. New defects / verification\n\n**Telemetry is clean** (verified in code): `ConvertTo-TelemetryDetails` `common.ps1:9001-9046` emits only closed enums (engine/purpose/outcome), charset-constrained provider/model that reject path/drive shapes, and numeric counts/booleans/versions; `title`=outcome enum, `tags`=[engine,provider]; no path/task/prompt/thread/user/machine. `instance_id`=SHA-256(salt‖machine name) `8902-8937`, name never in clear. One function `Get-TelemetrySwitch` is read identically by run/member/hook/sender (fail-closed). `-Complain` sends operator-typed text by design (shown + confirmed).\n\nNew findings (all minor/note, in `findings[]`):\n1.
